title: Wrapping up
summary: Rowe and Chez close the interview before sound check.

blocks.x: Sounds like a good place to wrap up.
You are a good storyteller today and I look forward to hearing some stories tonight from you.
I’ve been blessed with the gift of gab, so I apologize for going on.
